# Aussie, Kiwi, & Taswegian backgrounds

![](images/aus_kiwi_taswegian_background_note.png){style="width:200px" fig-align="center"}

D20 investigator backgrounds for the Liminal Horror TTRPG.

Designed to represent regular and peculiar workers found in Australia, New Zealand, and Tasmania in the 2020s.


1. **A/C Technician:** Gas detector, Inspection camera, Temperature probes, Wrench (d6)
2. **Animation/VFX Artist:** 3D camera, Drawing tablet, Laptop, Mocap suit
3. **Cellar hand:** Bottle of wine, Corkscrew, Siphon tube and hand pump, Sulphur burner for barrel sanitisation and matches
4. **Film Extra:** Campervan keys, Chainmail (1 armor), Facial prosthetics kit, Power bank
5. **Fruit Picker:** Fruit snipper (d6), Picking bag, Telescopic fruit picker, Hat and SPF 50
6. **Golf Caddie:** Loaded cooler, Electrolyte tablets, 24 Golf balls and tees, Golf club (d6)
7. **Jackaroo/Jillaroo:** Insulated jug, Motorbike helmet (1 armor), Pocket knife (d6), Riding boots
8. **Lifeguard:** First aid kit, Rescue tube, Resuscitation kit, Whistle
9. **Martial Arts Trainer:** Gym sanitiser and cloth, Judo gi, Katana (d8, *quick*), Medals
10. **Miner:** Grease gun, Mining drill (d6), Miner’s helmet with headlamp (1 armor), Respirator
11. **Nature Guide:** Camp stove, First aid kit, Satellite phone, Tent and sleeping bag
12. **Pearl Farm Diver:** Breakaway zip ties, Golden pearl (1 stability), Pearl extraction and nucleation kit (Shell opener, tweezers, scissors, scalpel etc.), Powerhead (d8, **complex**)
13. **Pilot:** Sunglasses, Flare gun (d6, burning), Single engine propellor aircraft keys, Torch
14. **Roadkill Collector:** Bug spray, Nitrile gloves, Machete (d6), Trashbags and duct tape
15. **Sand Artist:** Bucket, Shovel (d6), Sculpting tools, Spray bottle
16. **Supermarket Employee:** Biscuits, Hard hat (1 armor), Multitool, Utility knife (d6)
17. **Surfer:** Shell necklace (1 stability), Surfboard, Wax, Wetsuit
18. **Tradie:** Drill (d6), Reciprocating saw (d6), Tool box with tools, Work gloves (1 armor)
19. **Venom Milker:** Anti-venom, Glass jars and parafilm, Kevlar gloves and face shield, Snake gaiters (1 armor)
20. **Zookeeper:** Knife (d6), Thermal camera, Walkie talkie pair, Whistle
